name: Storm Crag Whelp
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The crag whelp makes two Talons attacks.

Actions.name: Talons
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Thunder Wall (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Rolling Wake
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* The target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: a young storm drake whose breath is a rolling wall of thunder
Actions.expresses: a rolling wall of thunder breath

lore: Hatched in the boiling updrafts beneath a storm-scarred crag, it ranges the high country chasing thunderheads to keep its breath charged and resents anything on the ground that won't scatter.
